- `git_context`(format?="summary"|"files"|"diff", path?, max_lines?): Get git repository context (status, changed files, or diff).
- `glob`(pattern): Find files matching a glob pattern.
- `write_file`(path, content, repair_plan?): Create a file or replace its complete contents. Use str_replace for a localized exact edit.
- `str_replace`(file_path, old_str, new_str, repair_plan?): Replace an exact string in a file. Use for localized edits; use write_file when replacing complete file contents.
- `read_range`(file_path, start_line, end_line): Read a specific line range from a file. Use this instead of read_file when you only need a portion of a large file. Lines are 1-indexed and inclusive.
- `todo_write`(todos): Create and manage a structured task list for your current coding session. Use this to track progress on complex multi-step tasks. Merge-patch semantics: todos with new IDs are added, existing IDs are updated, omit to remove.
- `apply_patch`(patch, repair_plan?): Apply a unified diff patch to a file.
- `run_command`(command, cwd?, background?, detached?): Run an allowlisted command through the governed, shell-free executor. Quoted arguments are grouped; this is not a general shell. Set background=true for long-running jobs, then collect results with await_command. Background jobs use the same project scope and policy checks as foreground commands.
- `await_command`(task_id, timeout_seconds?): Wait for a background shell job started via run_command(background=true). Returns exit code, stdout, and stderr when complete, or timed_out=true if still running (await timeout does not kill the job; the job still has its own hard timeout).
- `test_run`(command, cwd?, timeout_seconds?): Run a test command with extended timeout (preferred for test suites).
- `mcp_tool_search`(server, query?): Search available tools on a configured MCP server.
- `mcp_request`(server, query): Call a tool on an MCP server. Query is tool name plus JSON arguments.
- `web_search`(query): Search the web for information.
- `web_fetch`(url): Fetch and read the contents of a URL.
- `sub_agent`(task, instructions?, write_scope?, mutation?, model?, max_rounds?): Spawn a sub-agent for an investigation or mutation. - `read_file`(path): Read the contents of a file at the given path.
- `list_dir`(path): List the contents of a directory.
- `grep`(pattern, path?): Search file contents using a regular expression pattern, optionally scoped to a file or directory.
- `semantic_search`(query, limit?): Semantic search across the repository index.
- `git_context`(format?="summary"|"files"|"diff", path?, max_lines?): Get git repository context (status, changed files, or diff).
- `glob`(pattern): Find files matching a glob pattern.
- `write_file`(path, content, repair_plan?): Create a file or replace its complete contents. Use str_replace for a localized exact edit.
- `str_replace`(file_path, old_str, new_str, repair_plan?): Replace an exact string in a file. Use for localized edits; use write_file when replacing complete file contents.
- `read_range`(file_path, start_line, end_line): Read a specific line range from a file. Use this instead of read_file when you only need a portion of a large file. Lines are 1-indexed and inclusive.
- `todo_write`(todos): Create and manage a structured task list for your current coding session. Use this to track progress on complex multi-step tasks. Merge-patch semantics: todos with new IDs are added, existing IDs are updated, omit to remove.
- `apply_patch`(patch, repair_plan?): Apply a unified diff patch to a file.
- `run_command`(command, cwd?, background?, detached?): Run an allowlisted command through the governed, shell-free executor. Quoted arguments are grouped; this is not a general shell. Set background=true for long-running jobs, then collect results with await_command. Background jobs use the same project scope and policy checks as foreground commands.
- `await_command`(task_id, timeout_seconds?): Wait for a background shell job started via run_command(background=true). Returns exit code, stdout, and stderr when complete, or timed_out=true if still running (await timeout does not kill the job; the job still has its own hard timeout).
- `test_run`(command, cwd?, timeout_seconds?): Run a test command with extended timeout (preferred for test suites).
- `mcp_tool_search`(server, query?): Search available tools on a configured MCP server.
- `mcp_request`(server, query): Call a tool on an MCP server. Query is tool name plus JSON arguments.
- `web_search`(query): Search the web for information.
- `web_fetch`(url): Fetch and read the contents of a URL.
- `sub_agent`(task, instructions?, write_scope?, mutation?, model?, max_rounds?): Spawn a sub-agent for an investigation or mutation. Delegated children are scheduled sequentially in this release (see #214); set mutation to true for write access. Optional model override for per-agent model selection.
